name: Nasr Min Allah wa Fathun Qareeb Wall Art
summary: Gold Arabic calligraphy above crossed silver-tone decorative shapes.
description: The gold lettering reads “Nasr min Allah wa fathun qareeb,” a phrase from Surah As-Saff (61:13). The reflective crossed shapes and black handles frame the lettering for a wall display.
alt: Gold Arabic calligraphy above crossed mirror-finish decorative blades with black handles

name: Allahu Noor Emerald and Gold Wall Art
summary: A rectangular emerald-green panel with gold calligraphy and ornamental corners.
description: The composition highlights the opening words of the Light Verse from Surah An-Nur (24:35). Gold lettering stretches across the green panel, with a circular script detail in the center and matching corner ornaments.
alt: Emerald green rectangular Allahu Noor calligraphy panel with gold lettering and four ornate corners

name: Ayatul Kursi Black and Gold Droplet Frame
summary: Gold Ayatul Kursi calligraphy in a droplet-shaped composition on a black panel.
description: The opening words of Ayatul Kursi from Surah Al-Baqarah (2:255) stand out against an intricate border of flowing Arabic script. A gold-tone rectangular rim frames the dark background and ties in with the lettering.
alt: Black square Ayatul Kursi panel with a gold frame and gold droplet-shaped Arabic calligraphy

name: Black and Gold Arch Pendulum Wall Clock
summary: A black wall clock with gold-tone markers and an elongated arch silhouette.
description: Nested arches sit above the round dial, while the lower loop frames a slim pendulum detail. Gold-tone hands and hour markers stand out against the black face, with a red seconds hand for contrast.
alt: Black arch wall clock with gold hour markers and a pendulum detail in its lower loop

name: Salam Ya Rasul Allah Emerald Scalloped Plaque
summary: Gold salutation calligraphy on a green plaque with a scalloped outline.
description: The Arabic greeting “Assalamu alayka ya Rasul Allah” spans an emerald-green field. Reflective gold lettering, a scalloped frame and small side ornaments give the panel a balanced silhouette.
alt: Green scalloped wall plaque with gold Salam Ya Rasul Allah calligraphy and matching side ornaments

name: Alhamdulillah Black and Gold Wall Plaque
summary: Vertical gold Alhamdulillah lettering framed by four decorative corners.
description: The phrase “Alhamdulillah,” meaning “Praise be to Allah,” is arranged vertically on a glossy black panel. Small gold-tone corners keep the focus on the sweeping center strokes.
alt: Vertical black wall plaque with gold Alhamdulillah calligraphy and decorative corners

name: Bismillah Black and Gold Horizontal Plaque
summary: A long black panel with gold Bismillah calligraphy and ornamental corners.
description: The full Bismillah phrase runs across the face of the plaque. Its extended gold stroke balances the denser script at the opposite side, making the piece suited to a wide section of wall.
alt: Horizontal black Bismillah plaque with gold Arabic lettering and gold corner ornaments

name: Bismillah White Mirror-Finish Plaque
summary: Reflective Bismillah calligraphy on a white rectangular background.
description: The white background gives the Arabic calligraphy a bright, understated setting. The mirrored lettering and four small corner flourishes reflect the surrounding light.
alt: White horizontal Bismillah wall plaque with reflective Arabic lettering and ornate corners

name: Mashallah Emerald and Gold Plaque
summary: A green horizontal plaque with bold gold Mashallah lettering.
description: The gold phrase “Mashallah” stretches across the green face. The clipped-looking corners and small gold accents keep the silhouette simple.
alt: Emerald green horizontal Mashallah plaque with gold calligraphy and clipped-corner accents

name: Allah and Muhammad Gold Teardrop Wall Art Pair
summary: Two matching gold-tone teardrops carrying the names Allah and Muhammad.
description: Each name sits inside its own open teardrop outline. The paired reflective forms can be arranged together as a balanced wall display.
alt: Two matching reflective gold teardrops with the names Allah and Muhammad

name: Kiswah-Inspired Kaaba Door Wall Panel
summary: A tall black wall panel with bands of gold and silver-tone Arabic ornament.
description: Inspired by the decorated curtain at the door of the Kaaba, this panel brings together layered borders, medallion forms and a silver-tone central inscription against a black and gold palette.
alt: Tall black and gold Kiswah-inspired wall panel with ornamental bands and a silver-tone central inscription

name: Black Crescent and Butterfly Wall Clock
summary: A black crescent-shaped clock with gold numerals and a butterfly silhouette.
description: The round dial sits inside an open crescent, with a trail of butterfly shapes sweeping around the right side. Warm gold numerals stand out against the black face.
alt: Black crescent wall clock with a trail of butterflies and gold numerals on the dial

name: Emerald Mosque and Crescent Wall Clock
summary: A round green clock with a mosque silhouette, crescent and ornamental latticework.
description: A gold-tone dome anchors the mosque motif above the clock dial. A crescent, open latticework and smaller devotional motifs sit within the green circular outline.
alt: Emerald round wall clock with mosque and crescent motifs, latticework and gold-tone hands

name: Black Geometric Lattice Wall Clock
summary: A black numbered dial surrounded by an open angular lattice.
description: Intersecting lines create a faceted frame around the clock face. White numerals and gold-tone hands make the central dial stand out from the geometric surround.
alt: Black geometric wall clock with an open faceted frame, white numerals and gold-tone hands

name: Subhanallah Black and Gold Wall Plaque
summary: Gold Subhanallah lettering on a black panel with ornate corner details.
description: The phrase “Subhanallah,” meaning “Glory be to Allah,” fills a tall rectangular panel. The black background keeps the gold lettering and corner motifs in focus.
alt: Vertical black wall plaque with gold Subhanallah calligraphy and four decorative corners

name: Gold Calligraphy Halo Wall Clock
summary: A black round dial encircled by openwork gold-tone Arabic calligraphy.
description: The gold-tone script forms a broad decorative halo around the dial. The black face, contrasting numerals and slim hands give the center a clear, simple layout.
alt: Black round clock with gold-tone hands and an openwork gold Arabic calligraphy surround

name: Black Allah Rosette Wall Art
summary: A dark rosette with a pointed outline and a contrasting central Allah calligraphy motif.
description: Layered-looking rings and geometric details move outward from the central lettering. The pointed black silhouette stands out on light walls.
alt: Black pointed rosette wall art with a contrasting Allah calligraphy center

name: Mashallah Black Open-Script Wall Art
summary: Glossy black Mashallah lettering in an open-script form.
description: The flowing phrase creates a simple horizontal silhouette against the wall. The dark finish suits a light wall or a grouping of smaller calligraphy pieces.
alt: Glossy black Mashallah wall art with freestanding Arabic letterforms

name: Gold Rosette Corner Accent Pair
summary: Two gold-tone corner ornaments with open rosette details.
description: The matching ornaments use triangular outlines, circular floral motifs and pierced borders. Display them as a pair around a frame, wall feature or decorative arrangement.
alt: Two gold-tone geometric corner accents with open floral rosettes

name: Bismillah Black and Gold Wall Hook Rack
summary: Two-tone Bismillah calligraphy with a compact row of hooks underneath.
description: The wall rack pairs black and gold-tone Arabic lettering with lower hooks for small everyday items. Its narrow outline fits an entryway arrangement.
alt: Black and gold Bismillah calligraphy rack with a row of small hooks
